name: District portals — bank branch/office lists (Sylhet, Habiganj, Moulvibazar)
notes: No licence stated; lists are undated. Only landline numbers are kept (mobile numbers dropped: Sylhet 2); Habiganj's 5-digit local office numbers (no area code printed) are kept in extra_json only; no e-mails, routing numbers, managers' names, residence numbers or coordinates. Moulvibazar rows naming several branches or 'various upazila branches' are left out (বাংলাদেশ কৃষি ব্যাংক (মৌলভীবাজার ও বিভিন্ন উপজেলা শাখা); ইউনাইটেড কমার্শিয়াল ব্যাংক (কুলাউড়া / শ্রীমঙ্গল / মৌলভীবাজার শাখা)). Not used: Sunamganj (its bank list has names only; every branch/address/phone field is empty). sylhet.gov.bd sends only its leaf certificate: the Let's Encrypt intermediates are added from the CA's AIA URLs, TLS verification stays on.
